title: Chicken Shawarma Pitas
shortDescription: Warm-spiced chicken with pickles and garlic sauce in pita
subtitle: Warm-spiced chicken with pickles and garlic sauce in pita
description: Chicken thighs marinate in yogurt and a warm shawarma spice blend, roast or grill, and slice into pita with pickled vegetables, tomato, and garlic-tahini sauce. Spice profile and pickles make this read shawarma, not Greek souvlaki.

steps.title: Marinate with shawarma spices
steps.instruction: Mix yogurt, lemon, cumin, coriander, turmeric, paprika, and garlic. Coat thighs and marinate at least 4 hours. The marinade should look golden from turmeric — that is the visual cue crews expect.

steps.title: Roast or grill chicken
steps.instruction: Roast at 425°F on sheet pans 25–30 minutes or grill until 175°F. Rest and slice thin. Charred edges are good — they sell shawarma flavour. Target oven/smoker temperature: 425°F.

steps.title: Make garlic-tahini sauce
steps.instruction: Blend tahini, garlic, lemon, and cold water until pourable and seasoned. It should be garlicky and nutty — thinner than tzatziki.

steps.title: Assemble shawarma pitas
steps.instruction: Warm pita. Spread garlic sauce, add chicken, pickles (pickled turnip, cabbage, or onion), and tomato. Fan one pita open for the line so pickles and spiced chicken are visible.

steps.title: Wrap and hold
steps.instruction: Fold, foil, and hold at 200°F up to 20 minutes. Pickles stay separate if holding longer than 30 minutes to keep crunch.

proTips: A pinch of cinnamon and cardamom in the spice mix adds depth without tasting sweet.
Store-bought pickled turnip from a Middle Eastern grocer is worth it for authenticity.
Side-by-side with Greek pitas, label trays — rookies confuse them if unlabeled.
leftovers: Garlic sauce as dip for pita chips
whyCrewsLikeIt: Different from Greek pitas on the same cycle — crews notice turmeric-cumin colour and pickles. Bar-night shawarma exists; this is the handheld pita version with clear pickle garnish.
mealPrepNotes: Pickles can be store-bought shawarma-style or quick red onion pickles. Marinate thighs overnight if possible. Slice chicken and hold with pan juices. Assemble open for the line.
